description: This PHP source file defines the RenameModules class used for renaming modules, their labels, related links, subpanels, dashlets, and associated language strings within the SuiteCRM application. It contains logic for processing user requests to rename modules and update all related UI elements and language entries accordingly.

classes.name: RenameModules
classes.description: Class responsible for handling the renaming of modules, labels, subpanels, related links, dashlets, and language strings within SuiteCRM. It manages user requests, processes renaming actions, and updates all relevant application components to reflect the new module names.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point to process the renaming operation based on options, such as saving changes or displaying the form.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the user interface for renaming modules, including dropdowns, buttons, and associated layout.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the renaming changes, updating language strings, related links, subpanels, and dashlets, then redirects if specified.

methods.name: renameAllSubpanels
methods.description: Renames subpanels for all modules by updating their label strings.

methods.name: renameModuleSubpanel
methods.description: Renames subpanel titles for a specific module based on the changes.

methods.name: getSubpanelDefs
methods.description: Retrieves subpanel definitions for a given module's SugarBean object.

methods.name: renameAllRelatedLinks
methods.description: Renames related link labels across all modules.

methods.name: renameModuleRelatedLinks
methods.description: Renames related link labels in a specific module.

methods.name: clearLanguageCaches
methods.description: Clears cached language files to ensure updates take effect.

methods.name: renameAllDashlets
methods.description: Renames dashlet titles associated with renamed modules.

methods.name: changeModuleDashletStrings
methods.description: Renames dashlet title strings for a specific module.

methods.name: changeAllModuleModStrings
methods.description: Iterates over all changed modules to update their module strings.

methods.name: renameCertainModuleModStrings
methods.description: Handles renaming of specific module strings for a module, targeting keys that need updating.

methods.name: changeCertainModuleModStrings
methods.description: Renames specified module string labels for a target module based on renaming data.

methods.name: changeModuleModStrings
methods.description: Updates general module labels such as links and titles for a specific module.

methods.name: formatModuleLanguageKey
methods.description: Formats language keys dynamically based on module naming conventions.

methods.name: replaceSingleLabel
methods.description: Replaces a label's value with the renamed string, handling plural/singular cases and case modifiers.

methods.name: changeAppStringEntries
methods.description: Updates application dropdowns and related string entries to reflect renamed modules.

methods.name: createModuleListSingularPackage
methods.description: Prepares data package for updating module lists in dropdowns.

methods.name: getChangedModules
methods.description: Detects which modules have been renamed by comparing current and previous language strings.

methods.name: getModuleSingularKey
methods.description: Returns the singular form of a module name based on its object name property.

methods.name: getRenamedModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that have been renamed.
